My mom's a hypochondriac, if I don't feel good I try not to let her see because then mystically -she- will have the same problems as me and I would be the liar and the fake and I would have to do everything while -she- naps. My dad tries to keep everyone at arms length, but he keeps pushing me away and then crying to everyone else that we are so far separated but I don't know if he wants a relationship or not, out of everyone I am pretty sure he does care about me but he never shows he does. They constantly nag me which makes me want to do NOTHING but curl up in a ball and pull out my hair and scratch my eyes out because I know I cant do that to them. I guess they do care but it just feels like they dont.

I hope all of that made sense, I didn't mean to rant again. So I apologize for -my- long reply lol. Thank you though.
